affordability.title: Purchase impact
affordability.entrySubtitle: See what a purchase would do to this month's plan.
affordability.intro: See what one purchase would do to this month's plan. It's a calculation, not advice.
affordability.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.

result.within: Based on your current plan, you would have {{after}} left this month after the purchase.
result.over: Your current plan has {{before}} left this month. After the purchase, it would be {{after}} below zero.
result.alreadyOver: Your current plan is already {{before}} below zero. After the purchase, it would be {{after}} below zero.
result.incomplete: This month's income isn't registered, so LifeSort can't calculate what would be left. Add this month's income to see the purchase impact.

affordability.cannotCalculate: LifeSort can't calculate what this amount would mean for the plan.

assumptions.registered: It uses the income and spending registered in LifeSort, including fixed expenses due this month.
assumptions.noForecast: Future income and purchases are not forecast.
assumptions.noCredit: Credit, loans, overdrafts and buy now, pay later are not included.
assumptions.savings: Savings goals are kept separate: they are not added as money you can spend, and moving money to a goal does not count as spending.
assumptions.notSaved: The purchase is not saved – it is only a calculation.
assumptions.sameFigures: The figures are the same as in your Economy overview.
